35447460.model_description: GAC-Net, a CNN with a graph convolutional network attention module, automatically segments the fetal skull boundary in ultrasound images to measure head circumference.

35622711.clinical_problem: automatically measuring Cobb angle from whole-spine radiographs in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, compared to manual measurement
35622711.patient_population: 500 adolescent idiopathic scoliosis individuals (200 training, 300 validation)
35622711.model_description: A fully automated deep learning framework identifies vertebral boundaries and landmarks on whole-spine radiographs to automatically calculate Cobb angles (proximal thoracic, main thoracic, thoracolumbar/lumbar curves) in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.
35622711.headline_result: mean absolute error 2.92 degrees (major curve), ICC 0.967, r=0.972; 88.7% within +/-5 degrees

35655731.model_family: handcrafted feature engineering (LPQ, HOG) with shallow classifiers (kNN, SVM, decision tree, naive Bayes, linear discriminant)
35655731.clinical_problem: automated classification of fetal sex from ultrasound images to reduce misdiagnosis, particularly relevant for X-linked genetic disorders
35655731.patient_population: 339 male and 332 female fetal ultrasound images
35655731.model_description: PFP-LHCINCA extracts handcrafted textural and directional features (via pyramidal patch decomposition, local phase quantization, histogram of oriented gradients) from fetal ultrasound images and classifies fetal sex using shallow machine learning classifiers.
35655731.headline_result: sex classification accuracy >=88% across classifiers; >98% with kNN and SVM

35751202.exclusion_reason: general deep-learning architecture-search method benchmarked across mixed adult cancer, histopathology, and obstetric ultrasound datasets; not a pediatric-focused study

35957604.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI functional connectivity analysis of screen exposure in children; no AI/ML component, not diagnostic imaging

36048518.body_region: fetal / obstetric (fetal viability, multiple pregnancy, placenta, amniotic fluid, fetal presentation, biometry)
36048518.clinical_problem: enabling nonexpert-acquired obstetric ultrasound scans to be interpreted by machine learning, to improve prenatal risk-assessment access in underserved regions
36048518.patient_population: pregnant women scanned at UK and India clinical centers, from 11 weeks gestation through birth
36048518.model_description: The CALOPUS protocol collects nonexpert-acquired obstetric ultrasound sweeps with video and label annotations to train machine learning algorithms addressing fetal viability, multiple pregnancy, placental location, amniotic fluid volume, fetal presentation, and biometry.
36048518.study_design: prospective multinational protocol study for machine learning development

36063973.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI connectivity analysis of callous-unemotional traits and empathy in adolescents; no AI/ML component

36117128.clinical_problem: noninvasively diagnosing bone marrow involvement in pediatric neuroblastoma using PET/CT radiomics instead of biopsy
36117128.model_description: A radiomics nomogram combining 18F-FDG PET/CT radiomic features, conventional PET parameters, and clinical risk factors diagnoses bone marrow involvement in pediatric neuroblastoma, using bone marrow biopsy as the reference standard.

36162409.exclusion_reason: general review of pulmonary functional MRI image-processing/quantification methods; not specifically AI/ML-focused nor pediatric-specific

36223683.model_family: multi-modal deep neural network (video captioning with gaze/attention)
36223683.clinical_problem: automatically generating spoken-sonography-style captions describing fetal ultrasound scan videos to support documentation and education
36223683.model_description: A multi-modal deep neural network takes fetal ultrasound video, sonographer eye-gaze tracking, and speech transcriptions as input and generates natural-language captions describing the scan content and sonographer actions.

36301513.model_family: statistical shape model with linear discriminant analysis
36301513.clinical_problem: improving antenatal diagnosis of coarctation of the aorta using three-dimensional shape analysis of the fetal aortic arch
36301513.patient_population: 112 fetuses with suspected coarctation of the aorta
36301513.model_description: A statistical shape modeling pipeline extracts 3D centerline shape features of the fetal aortic arch from cardiac MRI and uses linear discriminant analysis to classify true coarctation of the aorta versus false-positive cases.
36301513.dataset_size: 112 fetuses with suspected coarctation of the aorta
36301513.headline_result: AUC 0.907 for coarctation-of-the-aorta shape risk score classification

36349567.exclusion_reason: functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) signal classification for autism; non-radiologic optical neuroimaging, akin to EEG signal analysis

36494000.exclusion_reason: pharmaceutical mini-tablet quality control via micro-CT; not a clinical/patient imaging study

36573004.model_family: deep learning-based automated segmentation software (two commercial vendor suites: Medis Suite, SuiteHeart)
36573004.clinical_problem: automatically segmenting left/right ventricle for biventricular size and function assessment in children with and without congenital heart defects
36573004.patient_population: 80 children (20 each: healthy, LV-CHD, tetralogy of Fallot, univentricular CHD), ages ~8.9-16.4 years
36573004.model_description: Two fully automated commercial software suites (Medis Suite, SuiteHeart) segment left and right ventricles on pediatric cardiac MRI to calculate biventricular volumes and masses, compared to manual segmentation, in children with and without congenital heart defects.
36573004.release_evidence: two fully automated software suites (Medis Suite 3.2, Medis, Leiden, the Netherlands and SuiteHeart 5.0, Neosoft LLC, Pewaukee, USA)
36573004.headline_result: left ventricle ICC 0.96-0.97 (healthy children); right ventricle ICC 0.62-0.94 (larger errors)

36576515.model_family: AI-assisted bone age assessment systems (Greulich-Pyle, Tanner-Whitehouse TW3-RUS, China05 RUS-CHN)
36576515.clinical_problem: evaluating AI-assisted bone age assessment and adult height prediction accuracy in girls with early/precocious puberty
36576515.patient_population: 726 girls with early puberty, 87 of whom had reached adult height (1,663 left-hand radiographs)
36576515.model_description: Three AI-assisted bone age assessment methods (Greulich-Pyle, TW3-RUS, RUS-CHN) and three adult height prediction methods (CH05, TW3, Bayley-Pinneau) were compared against actual adult height in Chinese girls with early puberty using left-hand radiographs.
36576515.dataset_size: 1,663 left-hand radiographs from 726 girls with early puberty
36576515.headline_result: TW3 predicted adult height within +/-5 cm in 92.9% of cases, overestimating by 0.4+/-2.8 cm; CH05 underestimated by 2.9+/-3.6 cm

36583731.clinical_problem: noninvasively diagnosing liver fibrosis in children with pancreaticobiliary maljunction to guide preoperative decision-making
36583731.patient_population: 136 children with pancreaticobiliary maljunction from two centers (111 center A, 25 center B)
36583731.model_description: A radiomics-clinical nomogram combining MRI radiomic features from segmented liver parenchyma with clinical factors noninvasively diagnoses liver fibrosis in children with pancreaticobiliary maljunction, validated against histopathology.
36583731.dataset_size: 136 children (111 center A: 74 training/37 internal validation; 25 center B external validation)

37492680.clinical_problem: reviewing how AI can automate image acquisition, interpretation and outcome prediction in pediatric echocardiography
37492680.patient_population: pediatric cardiology / echocardiography patients (narrative review, no specific cohort)
37492680.model_description: A state-of-the-art review of machine learning applications in pediatric echocardiography, covering automation of image acquisition and interpretation, and using echo-derived data to better understand cardiac physiology and outcomes.

32043232.exclusion_reason: resting-state fMRI functional connectivity group comparison of working memory in adolescents with epilepsy; no AI/ML component

33653299.model_family: random forest, linear regression, artificial neural network (compared)
33653299.body_region: fetal (biparietal diameter, abdominal circumference, estimated fetal weight)
33653299.clinical_problem: predicting newborn body mass index using prenatal ultrasound measurements and maternal/delivery information
33653299.patient_population: 3,159 obstetric patients and newborns, nationwide multicenter (Korea)
33653299.model_description: Machine learning models (random forest, linear regression, neural networks) use serial prenatal ultrasound biometry (biparietal diameter, abdominal circumference, estimated fetal weight) plus maternal and delivery information to predict newborn BMI.
33653299.dataset_size: 3,159 obstetric patients and newborns (nationwide multicenter, Korea)
33653299.headline_result: linear regression MSE 2.0744, random forest MSE 2.1610 (best performing models)

33888125.clinical_problem: predicting preoperative cerebrospinal fluid dissemination in children with medulloblastoma from MRI, to improve on imperfect MRI/CSF cytology
33888125.patient_population: 84 children with medulloblastoma (60 training, 24 internal validation, 40 external validation)
33888125.model_description: A combined clinical-MRI radiomics model uses features from preoperative contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI plus clinical characteristics to predict CSF dissemination in children with medulloblastoma before surgery.
33888125.dataset_size: 84 children (60 training, 24 internal validation, 40 external validation)

33932715.clinical_problem: reducing radiation dose in pediatric lung CT while maintaining image quality using newer scanner technology and deep learning reconstruction
33932715.patient_population: 23 size-matched pediatric patients per scanner (46 total), age 2-18 years
33932715.model_description: A 256-slice multidetector CT scanner using axial wide-cone acquisition and deep learning image reconstruction is compared to a standard 64-slice helical multidetector CT for pediatric lung CT, assessing radiation dose and image quality.
33932715.dataset_size: 23 pediatric patients per scanner (46 total), age 2-18 years
33932715.headline_result: effective dose reduced to 0.23+/-0.11 mSv (MDCT2) vs 1.13+/-0.58 mSv (MDCT1), p<0.001; subjective image quality not significantly different

34122531.clinical_problem: estimating age and gender from structural brain MRI in children and adolescents (including those with ASD/ADHD) to account for confounding variables in neurodevelopmental disorder assessment
34122531.patient_population: 894 healthy controls, 251 ASD, 357 ADHD (ABIDE-II and ADHD-200 public datasets)
34122531.model_description: A 3D CNN using voxel-based morphometry gray/white matter maps from structural brain MRI simultaneously estimates gender and age (a neurodevelopmental proxy) in children and adolescents with and without ASD/ADHD, with attention maps highlighting relevant brain regions.
34122531.headline_result: age mean absolute error 1.43 years (10-fold CV), 1.57 years (out-of-sample); gender AUC 0.85 (CV), 0.89 (out-of-sample)
34122531.study_design: retrospective multitask deep learning model development study using public datasets
